mappings.note: Who the author of this lesson is -- identifying the composition; LO-65 would be right only if a writing style were the answer.
What gets printed in today's newspapers -- a point stated in the essay, so the analyse-and-locate LO.
With what eye every person is now regarded -- the essay's charge that everyone is seen as a suspect, a social value judgement rather than a plain detail.
Who does not hesitate to exploit loopholes in the law -- social criticism, the samaajik-moolya LO.
What kind of accumulation India does not prize -- a cultural value the essay asserts.
What is held to be the ultimate ('charam aur param') -- the value the essay weighs.
The denomination the writer gave the ticket clerk -- a stated narrative detail.
What the conductor brought from the bus stand -- stated detail.
Who dreamt the dream of Bharatvarsh -- stated point in the essay.
Where India's great civilised culture sank -- the essay's lament about social decline, so the social-values LO.
Who is more troubled in today's climate -- inference from the essay's argument, stated in the text.
What has become the property of cowards and the helpless -- a value (honesty) being judged, not a detail.
Which pratyay is used in 'jeevika' -- word-formation grammar, the written language-system LO.
How faults are removed -- the essay's moral prescription, a social value.
Why relishing others' failings is called bad -- asks for the reason behind a value, which is exactly LO-62's 'uske kaaran jaanne ki koshish'.
What is relished -- a stated point; unlike q116748 it asks what, not why.
What goodness is -- a definition of a value.
Correct sandhi-vichchhed of 'doshodghaatan' -- sandhi, grammar.
Why the crowd was beating the driver -- narrative inference from the incident.
Whom the writer saved from the beating -- stated detail.
Where the bus conductor had gone -- stated detail.
Whose condition was worsening -- stated detail.
What the passengers did to the driver -- sequence of events.
Why the writer does not despair -- the essay's thesis about faith in human goodness, a social value.
The effect on life of dwelling on deceit -- a value judgement the essay argues for.
Which lesson the passage is taken from -- identifying the composition, paired with q116734.
What the 'a' in 'akaaran' is -- upsarg, word-formation grammar.
Meaning of the lokokti 'doodh ka doodh paani ka paani' -- proverb sense, the words-and-proverbs LO.
Antonym of 'aatma' -- word meaning.
Antonym of 'tarun' -- word meaning.
Antonym relating to 'patjhad' -- word meaning.
Which yugm (near-homophone pair) is correct -- discriminating the senses of similar words, so the word-meaning LO and not spelling grammar.
Which yugm pair is wrong -- same word-meaning discrimination.
Which word is misspelt -- vartani shuddhi, a written language-system item, not a meaning item.
Which word is correctly spelt -- vartani shuddhi.
Correct form of 'sanmaan' -- sandhi/spelling correction, grammar.
Which language 'chaay' comes from -- word-origin classification, part of the language system.
What a 'sankar' word is -- the grammatical category of hybrid words, so grammar rather than ordinary word meaning.
What kind of word 'relgaadi' is (sankar) -- word-origin classification.
Tadbhav form of 'darshan' -- tatsam/tadbhav grammar.
What kind of word 'sandhi' is -- word-origin classification.
What kind of word 'lota' is (deshaj) -- word-origin classification.
What kind of word 'kamal' is -- word-origin classification.
What kind of word 'paathshaala' is -- word formation/samas, grammar.
What kind of word 'dashaanan' is -- word formation/samas, grammar.
Which word is of Turkish origin -- word-origin classification.
What the written form of language is called -- metalanguage of the language system; the stem is clipped but the language-system intent is unambiguous.

What India's national language is -- general language awareness, not a skill any of the 19 LOs describes; cited at competency level rather than forcing LO-70, which is about USING the language system in writing.
What grammar tells us about a language -- metalanguage of the language system.
What kind of word 'pushp' is -- word-origin classification.
Place of articulation of u and oo -- phonology, part of the language system.
Which class of vowels e, ai, o, au are -- phonology.
How many kinds of maatra there are -- script and phonology.
Number of consonants in Hindi -- varnamala, the language system.
Place of articulation of ka-varga -- phonology.
Place of articulation of pa-varga -- phonology.
Place of articulation of ta-varga (retroflex) -- phonology.
Place of articulation of cha-varga -- phonology.
Antonym of 'rinaatmak' -- word meaning, not grammatical form.
Antonym of 'kalush' -- word meaning.
